name: Biossance Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Moisturizer
imageAlt: Illustration of a jar of face moisturizer
description: BIOSSANCE Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Face Moisturizer, 1.69 Fl Oz
features: DEEP HYDRATION AND DEFENSE: Biossance Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Moisturizer delivers weightless hydration through squalane while enhancing your skin's moisture barrier. Enjoy a visibly plumper complexion that stays hydrated throughout the day, defending against pollution and free radicals to keep your skin glowing.

EVEN SKIN TONE: Infused with fermented lemon peel and vitamin C, this facial moisturizer targets discoloration and uneven skin tone, creating a naturally radiant look. Achieve glass skin that radiates luminosity and confidence, perfect for those seeking a brightening cream solution.

SMOOTH FINE LINES AND WRINKLES: The rich antioxidant properties of this moisturizer help to smooth away fine lines, giving your face a youthful appearance. Experience the best in anti-wrinkle care with this effective wrinkle cream, perfect for daily use.

REJUVENATE WITH DAMASCUS ROSE: Enriched with Damascus rose extract, this face cream nourishes your skin while delivering a radiant, youthful glow. Enhance your skincare routine with this luxurious moisturizer face cream, perfect for both morning and night treatments.

VERSATILE LAYERING FOR OPTIMAL RESULTS: Suitable for all times of day, this moisturizing cream pairs perfectly with cleansers, serums, and SPF products. It's a hydrating moisturizer face cream that seamlessly integrates into any skincare routine, providing comprehensive care for healthier-looking skin.
